description: Land Acquisition - Kambarawa, Naula D/S Division, Matale District and Kokkuvil, Manmunai - North D/S Division, Batticaloa
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations for acquisition for public purposes. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in the context of authorizing the land acquisition process, not detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is exclusively about land matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
